title: Bato oyo batongi bandako milai
intro: Na eleko moko eleki kala, sivilizasio moko ya nguya ebimaki, oyo ekeseni na misala na yango ya kokamwa ya botongi mpe makasi na yango ya nsɔmɔ. Eloko wana ya lisanga epesamelaki biloko mingi mpe makoki ya nzoto, nzokande baponaki nzela ya koboya nsango ya bonzambe oyo etindamaki mpo na kotambwisa bango. Lisolo na bango ezali liteya mozindo na mikanda ya kala ya lisolo ya bato, litatoli ya mbuma mabe ya koboya bosolo.
clues: Bapesaki biso makasi mpe molai monene ya nzoto, na bokeseni na bato mosusu nyonso ya ntango na biso.
Toyebanaki mpo na kotonga bandako minene mpe makonzí milai na bisika nyonso ya likoló, kokanisaka ete tokozala na bomoi libela na libela.
Motindami moko uta na kati na biso atindamaki mpo na kokebisa biso, kobenga biso tosambela Allah se moko mpe totika bikeko na biso.
Totunaki na lolendo nyonso momemi-nsango na biso, totunaki soki bayaki epai na biso kaka mpo na kosala ete tósambela Allah mpe tótika oyo bankɔkɔ na biso bazalaki kosambela.
Mabele na biso epambolamaki na bilanga, maziba, mpe bilanga ya malamu, kasi tolobaki ete bozwi na biso eutaki na nguya na biso moko, kasi na Mozalisi na biso te.
Mpo na kozanga kondima mpe kosɛka na biso oyo eumelaki, nsukansuka tobebisamaki na mopɛpɛ moko ya nsɔmɔ mpe ya nkanda oyo ezalaki kosala mikolo mpe butu mingi.

trial.label: Momekano/Evenement
options: Kosɛngama ete bápesa kamela moko ya sikisiki mbeka
Kozala na défi ya kobimisa ba surahs zomi lokola Coran
Kokebisama na mosakoli moko mpo na mpela oyo ezali koya
Koboya mosakoli moko oyo akebisaki mpo na kotonga kolekisa ndelo mpe kosambela bikeko
trial.answer: Koboya mosakoli moko oyo akebisaki mpo na kotonga kolekisa ndelo mpe kosambela bikeko

location.label: Elemento ya ntina
options: Makonzí milai mpe bandako ya kofanda ya makasi
location.answer: Makonzí milai mpe bandako ya kofanda ya makasi

outcome.label: Resultat
options: Ebongwanaki na ba singe mpe ngulu
Ebebisamaki na mopɛpɛ moko ya nkake
Esilisamaki na mopɛpɛ moko ya nkanda makasi mpe ya kobebisa
outcome.answer: Esilisamaki na mopɛpɛ moko ya nkanda makasi mpe ya kobebisa

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
